description: This source file implements the `EvidenceService` class and associated exceptions, providing functionality for managing audit-linked evidence packages, including creation, retrieval, validation, and linking within an auditing system. It includes methods for handling evidence artifacts, manifests, and their integrity verification, with integrations to a database, file storage, and audit trail. It also defines custom error handling via the `EvidenceError` exception.

classes.description: Custom exception class for handling errors related to evidence operations.
